name: Clairette du Languedoc
terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.

blurb.text: A Languedoc-Roussillon appellation for white wine made only from Clairette. The rules allow still white wine and a white vin de liqueur.
